ns2:course.label: Analytical Systems 20thC Mus
ns2:course.description: Study of various analytical techniques developed for music written in the twentieth century based on compositional procedures other than those derived from the common practice period. Prerequisite: MUS 202 and MUS 208, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 202 and MUS 208, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
